spec_match.rationale: Checklist items are grounded in Google's published social-engineering definition (deceptive embedded content, look-alike forms, third-party served content) and the documented Search Console remediation path — the developer-facing side of what triggers WARN-grade signals.

interactive.rationale: Ten checkboxes drive a progress meter with live announcements and localStorage persistence, plus a lookup builder that constructs the real Transparency Report URL for the visitor's own domain.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises an interactive checklist plus a Transparency Report lookup builder; both are delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid domain input, storage failure, and reset paths are handled and tested, but the checklist necessarily cannot verify the visitor's actual site state — it is self-attested guidance, which the page could make more explicit per item.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry, Google Search Central's social-engineering documentation, Search Console, and the Transparency Report.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite applies; this concept's server-independent behaviors (persistence, URL building) are covered by telemetry assertions rather than conformance, which is correct since they are demo mechanics, not the feature contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP harness verified progress updates, real localStorage persistence, hostname extraction into the Transparency Report link (paul.kinlan.me), the invalid-input branch, and reset clearing storage; zero console errors; both class screenshots captured.

telemetry_health.rationale: ssw-playbook-persisted asserts the write-then-readback of progress on every change; ssw-lookup-url-built asserts (and honestly fails on) URL construction including the unparseable branch.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; progress uses accent-color emerald on paper; the reset button's light background also overrides color; check rows have AA text on ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Native checkboxes with for/id label pairing, aria-live progress output, keyboard-operable buttons with visible focus, and links that state their destination.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at both classes; mobile screenshot shows full-width inputs/buttons under 640px and legible checklist rows with comfortable targets.

openQuestions.title: Mark each checklist item as self-attested vs externally verifiable
openQuestions.detail: Items like 'verified in Search Console' could carry a small tag distinguishing what the owner can prove via an external tool (Transparency Report, Search Console) from what is self-assessment, making the checklist's epistemics explicit per row.

openQuestions.title: Consider a Web Risk / Safe Browsing Lookup API example for programmatic status checks
openQuestions.detail: Site owners with API keys can query the Safe Browsing Lookup v4 / Web Risk APIs for their own URLs. A snippet (not a live call — it needs a key) would extend the monitoring section for larger operators.

guidanceConsulted.query: persist checklist progress localStorage accessible live region updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce progress changes through a live region and keep state changes reachable and reversible from the keyboard.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The progress output is aria-live=polite, updated on every toggle and on reset; all controls are native and keyboard-operable with visible focus.

guidanceConsulted.query: domain input validation error feedback after interaction
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Validate on explicit user action and give timely, specific error feedback rather than preemptive errors.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The domain field validates only when Build is pressed; unparseable input gets a specific message echoing the rejected value, and the failure is also recorded as an honest telemetry assert failure branch.

summary: Practical concept: the site-owner's side of the feature — a persisted, announced 10-point checklist built from Google's social-engineering guidance plus a real Transparency Report lookup builder. Harness-verified persistence, link construction, invalid-input handling, and reset; 0 console errors; parity clean at both classes.
